en.description:
MyHealth is a health and fitness tracker that keeps your data where it belongs: on your device.

—— What you can track ——

ACTIVITY
Log walks, cycling, yoga, gardening, stairs and more from quick presets, or add your own.

WORKOUTS, RUNS AND HIKES
Dedicated logging for training sessions, runs and hikes, each with its own history.

DIET AND NUTRITION
Log meals and track what you are actually eating over time.

SLEEP
Record and review your sleep.

VITALS
A grid of the vitals you care about, kept in one place.

MEDICINE
Keep track of what you take and when.

BINDER
Your records, together, instead of scattered across apps and paperwork.

—— Reading and reference ——

ARTICLES
Health and wellbeing reading inside the app.

TOOLS
Calculators and reference material for the numbers you track.

—— Honest about what is a demonstration ——

Some screens in the Care section demonstrate capabilities that need clinical integrations this build does not have — the doctor finder, the MyChart/FHIR view, and the insurance, lab and prescription extractions. Those screens show clearly-labelled sample data and say so on screen. They are demonstrations of a direction, not live queries against your records, and the app never pretends otherwise.

—— Private by default ——

Your logs live on your device. Sign-in is optional — tap "Continue as guest" and everything works. The app asks for consent before it begins, and a production build carries no QA credentials.

—— Not a medical device ——

MyHealth is for general wellbeing and self-tracking. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose or treat anything, and nothing in it is medical advice. Talk to a qualified clinician about your health, and never change a treatment because of something this app showed you.

en.release_notes:
First release of MyHealth.

• Track activity, workouts, runs and hikes
• Log diet and nutrition, sleep, vitals and medicines
• A binder that keeps your records together
• Health articles and reference tools in-app
• Sign-in is optional - "Continue as guest" unlocks everything
• Your logs stay on your device

Care screens that need clinical integrations show clearly-labelled sample data and say so on screen. MyHealth is not a medical device and gives no medical advice.

Feedback: contact@safecodeg.com

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing MyHealth.

MyHealth is a self-tracking health and fitness app. Sign-in is OPTIONAL: tap "Continue as guest" on the login screen and every feature is available. No demo account is needed - and a production build deliberately carries no QA credentials (lib/app_env.dart rejects a prod release that does). Some Care screens are clearly-labelled demonstrations rather than live clinical queries; that labelling is on screen, not only in this note.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app, step through onboarding, and accept the consent screen.
2. On the login screen tap "Continue as guest". This is the intended review path; no account is required.
3. From the tab bar, open Activity and log an activity from the quick presets.
4. Open Diet to log a meal, and Sleep to record a night.
5. Open Vitals to see the vitals grid, and Medicine to add a medicine.
6. Open Care. The doctor finder, MyChart/FHIR view and the insurance, lab and prescription extraction screens display clearly-labelled sample data - they demonstrate a capability that needs a clinical integration this build does not have, and each screen says so.
7. Open More to reach Articles, Tools, Profile and the legal screens, which carry the not-a-medical-device disclaimer.

Privacy:
• Data collected: The health and activity entries you log yourself. Sign-in is optional; if you use it, your email is held by our authentication provider.
• Network: None is required to log or review your data - the app runs offline. Network is used only for optional sign-in.
• Location: Not required. Where a run or hike records a route, that stays on your device.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier and shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt. Health data is never used for advertising.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
